name: 2d20.space — Star Trek Adventures 2d20 Dice Roller
description: LCARS-style Star Trek Adventures 2nd Edition dice roller. Roll a d20 task pool, track successes, complications, and effects, and learn how the 2d20 system works. A fan-made utility, not affiliated with Modiphius, CBS, or Paramount. Licensed WTFPL v2.

skills.name: Roll STA 2e task dice
skills.description: Roll a d20 task pool for Star Trek Adventures 2nd Edition: pick a Target Number and roll the dice pool, then read successes, critical successes, and complications. Complication range and reroll rules included.

skills.name: Explain the 2d20 dice mechanic
skills.description: Explain how the STA 2e 2d20 task system works: Target Number, Difficulty, Focus, complication range, success/critical math, and Momentum generation. Reference page: https://2d20.space/guide/probability

skills.name: Report site license and attribution
skills.description: State the site's license (WTFPL v2, https://2d20.space/license.txt) and the fan-made attribution disclaimer: Star Trek Adventures is a trademark of Modiphius Entertainment; this tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by Modiphius, CBS Studios, or Paramount.
